name: PMETAL
recent: 近期公告主要是 EPF 及董事 Datuk Koon Poh Ming 的持股变动申报，属例行性质。新闻方面，市场关注 2026 年第三季盈利可能因铝价走弱而下滑，以及 2027 年氧化铝自给目标。
notable: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间连续多日申报持股变动。
董事 Datuk Koon Poh Ming 及 Datin Ong Soo Fan 于 10 月 21 日申报持股变动。
新闻指出公司目标在 2027 年实现氧化铝自给。
risks: 新闻预期 2026 年第三季盈利可能因铝价走弱而同比下降。
分析员指出 2026 年下半年冶炼利润率可能因铝供应紧张缓解而趋软。
外资连续五周从 Bursa 撤资，期间净流出 RM302m。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 4,687.95m，环比增长 14.4%，同比增长 11.9%；净利为 MYR 800.996m，环比增长 28.3%，同比增长 65.6%；净利率为 17.1%，高于上一季度的 15.2%。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly routine shareholding change filings by the EPF and Director Datuk Koon Poh Ming. In the news, focus is on a potential decline in Q3 2026 earnings due to weaker aluminium prices and the 2027 alumina self-sufficiency target.
notable_en: EPF filed shareholding change notices on multiple consecutive days from October to November.
Director Datuk Koon Poh Ming and Datin Ong Soo Fan filed shareholding change notices on 21 October.
News reported the company targets alumina self-sufficiency by 2027.
risks_en: News expects Q3 2026 earnings may decline year-on-year due to weaker aluminium prices.
Analysts noted smelting margins in 2H 2026 may soften as aluminium supply tightness eases.
Foreign funds withdrew RM302m from Bursa over a five-week selling streak.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 4,687.95m, up 14.4% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was MYR 800.996m, up 28.3% QoQ and 65.6% YoY; net margin was 17.1%, higher than 15.2% in the previous quarter.
